results.check: A fresh server has not run its first-run wizard
The first-run wizard completes with a throwaway administrator
Library Movies on the fixture folder
Library Shows on the fixture folder
A second, ordinary user exists
The fixtures carry the ids the Trakt stand-in reports
Trakt is not installed before the run
The server's catalog offers Trakt 31.0.0.0 for this server
Dashboard → Plugins → Trakt → Install puts it on the server
After a restart the installed copy reports id 4fe3201e-d6ae-4f2e-8917-e12bda571281, 31.0.0.0, Active
JellyfinMod Health reports Trakt installed with its version and lists trakt.history
The Trakt plugin starts device authorization and returns a user code
The code is approved on the stand-in, as a user entering it on trakt.tv would
The Trakt plugin reports the administrator authorized
The stand-in issued one token through the device flow; every call carried the plugin's API key and version
Before the sync the administrator has not played the movie or the episode
Before the sync JellyfinMod reports Trakt installed and no history anywhere
The Trakt plugin's import task is registered

detail.name: Import watched states and playback progress from trakt.tv

results.check: "Import watched states and playback progress from trakt.tv" completes
Jellyfin's database now has the movie and S01E01 played for the administrator, and nothing else
The second user's data is untouched
Jellyfin's API view of the same user data before a restart (information: upstream cache)
JellyfinMod reports Trakt history for the movie, S01E01, season 1 and the series
…and none for the unwatched movie, S01E02, S02E01 or season 2
The second user sees no Trakt history on any of them
Anonymous is 401
An unknown item is 404
The sync called the stand-in exactly as SyncFromTraktTask does, authorized, with the plugin's headers
After a restart Jellyfin's API reports the movie and S01E01 played, nothing else, and JellyfinMod's answers are unchanged
